content.title: 1-2-4-All: timed text coordination
content.summary: A fixed online group moves from solo reflection to pairs, quartets, and full-group sharing.
content.setup: Invite eight participants, choose a challenge, and assign every solo, pair, quartet, and full-group partition before the instance starts.
content.prompt: Work on the shared challenge chosen by the organizer.
content.participant: Follow the prompt and group shown for each timed stage. Text submission is optional and limited to one per stage; conversation may also happen outside the activity view.
content.completion: The timed sequence ends after full-group sharing. The app does not select which ideas are important.
content.access: The app displays stage prompts and group membership. Private reflection stays private; pair and quartet text is visible within that group; final-stage text is visible to the full group as it is posted.

provenance.credit: Inspired by 1-2-4-All, developed by Henri Lipmanowicz and Keith McCandless (Liberating Structures).
provenance.rights: Original example package wording for a research audit; source practice is separately credited and linked.

rounds.prompt: Read the shared challenge and prepare to reflect.
Share and build on ideas with your partner.
Bring the two pairs together and refine ideas.
Share ideas that the full group should hear.
